headline: Public hearings on a 6-story, 51-unit Elm Street building and a charitable gaming facility on South Willow Street.
summary: The agenda lists public hearings on subdivision, site plan, and conditional use applications. It also lists new applications for review, and several items are requested to be continued to July 16, 2026 or August 5, 2026.
items: S2026-005: Subdivision at Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30) to create 34 new buildable lots with new public roads and a wetland crossing. Continuance requested to August 5, 2026.
SP2026-009: Site plan at 285 Manchester Street (Tax Map 83, Lot 9) to convert a funeral home into a 9-dwelling unit building.

SP2026-010: Site plan at 1279 South Willow Street, 55 and 115 John E. Devine Drive, and 970 and 1050 Gold Street for a 73,240 sq. ft. charitable gaming facility with 1,086 parking spaces. Continuance requested to July 16, 2026.
CU2026-004: Conditional use permit at the same five properties to reduce required parking due to phased construction. Continuance requested to July 16, 2026.
S2026-011: Lot line adjustment at 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lots 6 and 7B). Continuance requested to July 16, 2026.

SP2026-011: Site plan at 1265 South Willow Street to raze a former fueling station and build a new fueling station with a convenience store and drive-through restaurant. Continuance requested to July 16, 2026.
CU2026-005: Conditional use permit at 1265 South Willow Street to reduce parking from 19 spaces to 14 spaces. Continuance requested to July 16, 2026.
CU2026-007 (new): Conditional use permit at 285 Manchester Street to reduce parking from nine spaces to eight for a 9-dwelling unit building.
SP2026-013 (new): Site plan at 231 Woodland Avenue (Tax Map 490, Lots 18 and 18A) to change a food processing plant into a landscape contractor's office with outside storage.
S2026-013 (new): Subdivision at 111 Villa Street (Tax Map 365, Lot 30) to split a 13,555 SF parcel into two lots.
S2026-014 (new): Subdivision at 30 Dawson Avenue (Tax Map 494, Lot 2) to split one lot into two lots.
S2026-012 (new): Subdivision at 103 Ray St (Tax Map 377, Lot 18) to split one lot into two lots.

SP2026-012 (new): Site plan at 1308 Elm Street (Tax Map 158, Lot 5) to redevelop a superette into a 6-story, mixed-use building with 51 residential units, 3,468 sq. ft. of commercial space, and a 25-vehicle parking garage.
location: City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers, One City Hall Plaza, Manchester, New Hampshire 03101

 MANCHESTER PLANNING BOARD 
PUBLIC HEARING MEETING AGENDA 
Thursday, July 2, 2026 – 6:00 PM 
City Hall, Third Floor – Aldermanic Chambers 
 
I. The Chair calls the meeting to order and introduces Planning Board members and Planning 
staff. 
 
II. PUBLIC HEARING: 
 
1. S2026-005 – Continued from May 21, 2026 
Property located at Wellington Road (Tax Map 860, Lot 30), a subdivision application for the 
creation of 34 new buildable lots with new public roads and a wetland crossing, in the Lake 
Massabesic Protection Overlay and R-1A Zoning District. Granite Engineering, LLC for 
Manchester Water Works. (Reviewed under current zoning ordinance).  
Request for continuance to August 5, 2026. 
 
2. SP2026-009 – Continued from June 4, 2026 
Property located at 285 Manchester Street (Tax Map 83, Lot 9) , a site plan application for the 
conversion of a funeral home into a 9- dwelling unit building,  in an MX -2 Zoning District. T.F. 
Moran, Inc. for ATI Property, LLC. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)  
 
3. SP2026-010 – Continued from June 4, 2026 
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a new site plan application for 
the redevelopment of five lots (formerly three lots) into a single lot of record for a proposed 73,240 
sq. ft. (formerly 63,175 sq. ft.) Charitable Gaming Facility with 1,086 parking spaces (formerly 
562) and the associated site improvements, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss & O’Neill, Inc. for 
Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)  
 Request for continuance to July 16, 2026. 
 
4. CU2026-004 – Continued from June 4, 2026 
Property located on 1279 South Willow Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 10) , 55 John E. Devine Drive 
(Tax Map 438, Lot 7B), 115 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, Lot 7), 970 Gold Street (Tax 
Map 875, Lot 7) and 1050 Gold Street (Tax Map 875, Lot 11) , a conditional use permit is for a 
reduction in required parking due to the phasing of construction. The applicant seeks to keep the 
existing facility until the new facility is granted occupancy, at such time the existing facility is to be 
razed and the remainder of the parking field would be completed, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss 
& O’Neill, Inc. for Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance) 
      Request for continuance to July 16, 2026.
Manchester Planning Board 
Public Hearing Meeting 
July 2, 2026   Page 2 of 3 
 
 
5. S2026-011 – Continued from June 4, 2026 
Properties located at 1265 South Willow Street and 55 John E. Devine Drive (Tax Map 438, 
Lots 6 and 7B) , a subdivision application to adjust the abutting lot lines located between Lots 6 
and 7B, where Lot 7B is to allocate 11,683 SF in area to Lot 6, resulting in a new total lot area of 
41,659 SF for Lot 6, in a BC-2 Zoning District. Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, 
Inc. and Granite State Poker Alliance, LLC. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)   
        Request for continuance to July 16, 2026. 
6. SP2026-011 – Continued from June 4, 2026 
Property located at 1265 South Willow Street (Tax Map 438, Lot 6) , a site plan application to 
raze a former fueling station and construct a  new fueling station with a conveni ence store, drive-
through restaurant , and a new fueling c anopy providing five double -sided fuel pumps and one 
kerosene pump, with associated site improvements, in a BC -2 Zoning District. Fuss and O’Neill, 
Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, Inc. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance) 
        Request for continuance to July 16, 2026. 
7. CU2026-005 – Continued from June 4, 2026 
Property located at 1265 South Willow Street (Tax Map 438, Lot 6) , a conditional use permit 
application to reduce on-site parking from the 19 spaces as required to 14 spaces provided, in a BC-
2 Zoning District . Fuss and O’Neill, Inc. for Aranosian Oil Company, Inc. (Reviewed under 
Current Zoning Ordinance)      
Request for continuance to July 16, 2026. 
 
 (New Items) 
With respect to the following applications, appropriate materials have been submitted to invoke the 
jurisdiction of the Board. Although additional information may be required prior to final 
consideration, it is the recommendation of Staff that the Planning Board determine the applications 
complete and conduct a public hearing. A motion would be in order. 
 
1. CU2026-007 
Property located at 285 Manchester Street (Tax Map 83, Lot 9) , a conditional use application for 
the reduction of parking spaces to eight where nine  are needed for a 9 -dwelling unit building in an 
MX-2 Zoning District.  T.F. Moran, Inc. for ATI Property, LLC.  (Reviewed under Current Zoning 
Ordinance) 
 
2. SP2026-013 
Property located at 231 Woodland Avenue (Tax Map 490, Lots 18 & 18A), a site plan 
application for a change in use from an existing food processing plant to a landscape contractor’s 
office with associated outside storage, with proposed on- site parking improvements, in an R -1B 
Zoning District. Keach-Nordstrom Associates, Inc. for Greywacke, LLC.  (Reviewed under Current 
Zoning Ordinance)  
 
3. S2026-013 
Property located at 111 Villa Street (Tax Map 365, Lot 30), an application to subdivide an 
existing parcel of 13,555 SF into two lots of 7,284 SF (Lot 30) and 6,271 SF (Lot 30A), where an 
existing two-family home is to remain on Lot 30 and a new single - or two-family house is to be 
constructed on Lot 30A in a Residential Two- Family (R-2) Zoning District. Joseph Wichert, LLS, 
Inc. for David and Gail Cote. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)
Manchester Planning Board 
Public Hearing Meeting 
July 2, 2026   Page 3 of 3 
 
 
4. S2026-014 
Property located at 30 Dawson Avenue (Tax Map 494, Lot 2), a subdivision application for the 
subdivision of one lot into two, where the new Lot 2 will have 8,368 SF and keep the existing 
house and where the new Lot 2A will have 7,094 SF in an R -1A Zoning District. Joseph M 
Wichert, L.L.S., Inc., for Shane Cunan. (Reviewed under Current Zoning Ordinance)  
 
5. S2026-012 
Property located at 103 Ray St (Tax Map 377, Lot 18), a subdivision application for the 
subdivision of one lot into two, where the new Lot 18 will have 10,500 SF and keep the existing 
house and where the new Lot 18A will have 5,250 SF in an R -1B Zoning District. Joseph M 
Wichert, L.L.S., Inc., for Christopher D. & Lauren C. DuPaul, and Rayne C.M. & Neil A. DuPaul. 
(Reviewed under Previous Zoning Ordinance)  
 
6. SP2026-012 
Property located on 1308 Elm Street (Tax Map 158, Lot 5) , a site plan application for the 
redevelopment of an existing superette into a 6- story, mixed- use, mid- rise building with 51 
residential units, 3,468 sq. ft. of commercial space, and a 25 vehicle parking garage, in a DT -1 
Zoning District. Northpoint Engineering, LLC for DEV, LLC.   
(Reviewed under Previous Zoning Ordinance)  
 
III. ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS: 
 
1. Review and approval of the Planning Board minutes of June 4, 2026. 
 
2. Distribution of the Planning Board minutes of June 18 , 2026, for review and approval at the 
meeting of July 16, 2026. 
 
3. Any other business items from the Planning Staff or Board Members. 
 
Full text of the agenda items is on file for review in the Planning & Community Development Department.
